finalText:
**Migrated all 12 remaining files** to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Files: `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `couponService.js`, `refund.js`, `returnService.js`, `supplier.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `shipment.js`, `teamService.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `cohort.js`, `session.js`.

One holdout left on purpose: `[vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js)`. Its header says it's a vendored copy overwritten wholesale on every upgrade, so local edits there get silently lost.

Next: raise the vendor file with whoever owns that dependency, since `db.query` is slated for removal.
